title: Refuse silently dropped test-request metadata at the public mailbox send boundary
outcome: Before a typed test-request producer is enabled, unsupported or malformed testRequest input is refused without sending ordinary mail; supported typed input follows the host-owned custody path.
acceptance: Behavioral HTTP and relevant bridge tests show that unsupported or malformed non-null testRequest input is refused without appending ordinary mail or causing a wake.
Ordinary mailbox sends retain their existing behavior; enabled supported typed requests are validated and carried through the existing custody owner rather than silently discarded.
